summary: Sends notes and controller changes from its tracks to a MIDI output device. It makes no sound itself; the device does.
use_for: Send notes and controller changes from its tracks to a MIDI output device.
quirks: It sends MIDI, not audio: the profile heard silence by design (health warn), and the device it drives was not tested: unverified.
Controller number 0 to 127 is a controller, 224 is the pitch wheel, anything else sends nothing; the value only goes out when it changes.
A note-off goes out on the channel its note went out on.
Channel is 0-based: raw 0 is MIDI channel 1.

track_parameters.name: Device
track_parameters.description: The MIDI output device, by its number in NeoBuzz Live's list
track_parameters.how: Chooses the MIDI output device this track sends to, by its number in the app's output list, 0 to 255 (0 by default).
track_parameters.sound: Nothing is heard in the song; the device you pick plays whatever this track sends.

track_parameters.name: MidiCC
track_parameters.description: The controller a new MidiCCValue goes to: 0–127 a controller number, 224 the pitch wheel; any other sends nothing
track_parameters.how: Chooses which controller a new Controller value goes to: 0 to 127 is a controller number, 224 is the pitch wheel, anything else sends nothing.
track_parameters.sound: It decides what the Controller value moves on the external device, such as modulation or volume.

track_parameters.name: MidiCCValue
track_parameters.description: Sent to MidiCC's controller when it changes: up to 127 for a controller (above, 127), 0–16383 for the pitch wheel (8192 its centre; above, 16383)
track_parameters.how: Sets the value sent to the chosen controller when it changes: 0 to 127 for a controller (higher is clipped to 127), 0 to 16,383 for the pitch wheel with 8,192 as its centre.
track_parameters.sound: It moves that controller on the external device; the wheel's centre leaves the pitch unbent.

track_parameters.name: Channel
track_parameters.description: The MIDI channel, 0 for channel 1 … 15 for 16: the track's notes and controller changes go out on it (a note's note-off on the channel the note went out on)
track_parameters.how: Chooses the MIDI channel this track's notes and controller changes go out on: raw 0 is channel 1, raw 15 is channel 16.
track_parameters.sound: Use a different channel per track to address different parts of a multi-timbral device.
